# Wheelora

> Design prototype of a car research website for India. All prices, reviews and dealers are demo data.

## Main sections

- [New cars](/new-cars): filter the catalogue by budget, body type, fuel and seats
- [Compare cars](/compare-cars): side-by-side specifications
- [Car news](/news): demo editorial stories
- [EMI calculator](/emi-calculator): illustrative loan estimates
- [Image credits](/image-credits): photo authors and licences
